confusions: Multi-step travel directions given in status/quest text (e.g. 'one west, then one out, then two west, then one in') were sometimes ambiguous about which room-exit label ('out' vs a compass direction) they referred to, causing a few wrong turns before finding locations like the Gallows Glade, the drowned nave, and the Wardmoor oath-stone.

It wasn't always obvious which grief-locations were the 'main' hold grief vs. optional side content (e.g. Cutter's Barrow, Hesper's/Hesk's huts) until visited — no strong signal to prioritize critical path vs. side content when time-limited.
suggestions: Let 'get your bearings' work from any room (not just specific landmark rooms) so players can always re-orient toward a quest target without backtracking.

In multi-step quest directions, use a single consistent vocabulary (either always compass directions or always named exits) rather than mixing 'north/south/east/west' with 'in/out/up/down' for the same path.
A short tag distinguishing a hold's critical-path grief location from optional flavor NPCs would help players manage time across 15 large holds.
The Old Court Evidence / Old Crypts side-thread at Barrowmere (0/3, 1/4) was interesting but never got clear direction on where to start it — a hint pointer would help.
